keyFindings.description: The new sentence says the daemon-launched controller's `GH_CONFIG_DIR` is "the project's default owner's directory". The runtime never derives it that way: the controller's launch spec carries no repository (internal/daemon/specs.go:86; controller_launch_test.go:77 asserts `launch.Repository.IsZero()`), so gitHubBundles passes owner "" to the credential function (internal/runtime/sandbox/relaunch.go:638), and appauth.GitHubCredential sets `bundle.Default = names[0]` over `slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(all))` — the alphabetically first owner of the project (internal/appauth/credential.go:52-59, comment at :26-29 "the first owner, sorted"). The same document already says so twice, at docs/kubernetes.md:3967 ("`github-default`, the first owner") and :4014 ("`GH_CONFIG_DIR` its first owner's directory there"), so this PR introduces a contradiction with the section its own pointer sends the reader to, in a change whose purpose is to stop the runbook stating a value no pod has. For a project with two owners (INFRA serves sjawhar/legion and theorem-labs/agent-infra) the project's default repository and the alphabetically first owner need not be the same. Fix: say "its first owner's directory" (matching :3967 and :4014), or drop the clause, which no acceptance criterion requires — AC1 asks only that the controller's difference in `LEGION_WORKSPACE` be stated.

`**Size:** 4 files changed, +313/−13` is stale: GitHub reports 307 additions / 13 deletions at head 976dac1f (`gh api repos/sjawhar/legion/pulls/2152 --jq '.changed_files, .additions, .deletions'` → 4, 307, 13). Round 2's +11/−6 moved it. Non-blocking; correct it with the push that answers the finding above.
